notes: Observations: 1) From study of the patterning of cord group by color in khipu VA16135a as compared to VA16135b it appears that cords are organized in sets of 14 cord groupings (each composed of ca. 11 pendants). Given that the end of the sequence in VA16135a appears to end one 14 set group and one of the broken ends of VA16135b begins a 14-set group the table for UR 231 runs continuously from VA16135a to VA 16135b. 2) Pendants 389-399, 533-542, 687-697, 844-854: vegetal fibers
